source.title: Solutions to Some Open Problems About Four Sombor-Index-Like Graph Invariants

accepted.question_text: For a finite graph G, let E(G) be the edge set of G and let d_u be the degree of a vertex u of G. Define the Sombor-index-like graph invariants SO5 and SO6 by SO5(G) = 2π times the sum over all edges uv in E(G) of |d_u^2 - d_v^2| divided by √(2 + 2√(d_u^2 + d_v^2)), and SO6(G) = π times the sum over all edges uv in E(G) of ((d_u^2 - d_v^2) divided by √(2 + 2√(d_u^2 + d_v^2)))^2. For a fixed order n, let T_n be the class of all trees with n vertices, and let CT_n be the class of all chemical trees with n vertices, where a chemical tree is a tree of maximum degree at most 4. What are the minimum and maximum possible values of SO5 and SO6 on T_n and on CT_n?
accepted.context_brief: Extremal SO5 and SO6 for trees and chemical trees

evidence.quote: Problem 1. Find the extremal values of the graph invariants SO5 and SO6 in the classes Tn and CT n.
partial solutions to Problems 1 and 3 are provided

accepted.question_text: For a finite graph G, let E(G) be the edge set of G and let d_u be the degree of a vertex u of G. Define the Sombor-index-like graph invariant SO4 by SO4(G) = (π/2) times the sum over all edges uv in E(G) of ((d_u^2 + d_v^2)/(d_u + d_v))^2. For a fixed order n, let T_n be the class of all trees with n vertices. What is the maximum possible value of SO4 on T_n?

evidence.quote: Problem 2. Find the maximum value of the graph invariants SO4 in the class Tn.

accepted.question_text: For a finite graph G, let E(G) be the edge set of G and let d_u be the degree of a vertex u of G. Define the Sombor-index-like graph invariant SO3 by SO3(G) = √2π times the sum over all edges uv in E(G) of (d_u^2 + d_v^2)/(d_u + d_v), and define SO4(G) = (π/2) times the sum over all edges uv in E(G) of ((d_u^2 + d_v^2)/(d_u + d_v))^2. For a fixed order n, let CG_n be the class of all connected graphs with n vertices. What are the maximum possible values of SO3 and SO4 on CG_n?
accepted.context_brief: Maximum SO3 and SO4 for connected graphs

trace.notes: Normalized the original zbMATH URL https://zbmath.org/7709258. Direct shell fetch of the zbMATH page returned a Cloudflare challenge, so the zbMATH REST API was used as resolver metadata and identified DOI 10.46793/match.90-2.505A and title Solutions to Some Open Problems About Four Sombor-Index-Like Graph Invariants.

Resolved the DOI to the MATCH article page and direct PDF URL. Shell download of the PDF failed with DNS resolution errors for match.pmf.kg.ac.rs, but the browser PDF reader loaded the exact matching PDF and it was used as the readable primary source.
